lede: Michigan carries the stronger underlying team rating — +5.4 against +0.3, a 5.1-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Minnesota +3.5 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Michigan winning 59% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is kicking, where Minnesota leads Michigan by 76 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 76% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
